entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For questions about an existing order or to make a return, please press one.
one
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex, I'd like to start a return for a jersey I bought recently.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-8675309.
Great, thank you. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloFit Aero Jersey in blue. And I see you're a VIP member, Ms. Evans. We really appreciate your loyalty.
Thanks. Yeah, I just need to return it.
Of course. May I ask why you're returning the jersey?
It's just **too small**. I thought a medium would work, but it's a bit tighter than I like.
I completely understand. Our aero fit can be snug. Well, you're well within the 90-day return window, so this is no problem at all. I can get this return started for you right now.
Perfect. What do I need to do on my end?

It's very simple. I'm emailing you a prepaid **return label** as we speak. Just pack the item back in its **original packaging**, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any FedEx location. There's no cost to you for the return shipping.
Oh, free return shipping? That's great.

It's one of the perks for our VIPs. Once our warehouse team receives and inspects the item, we'll issue a full **refund** to your original method of payment. You should see that reflected in your account within 3-5 business days.
That sounds easy enough. Thank you.

You're very welcome. And actually, to thank you for being a valued customer and to help you find the right size next time, I've gone ahead and added a $50 credit to your VeloFit account. You can use that on your next purchase.
Wow, fifty dollars? You really didn't have to do that. That's fantastic, thank you so much!
It's our pleasure, Ms. Evans. We want to make sure you get the gear that's right for you. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Nope, that's everything. You've made this incredibly easy. I really appreciate it.
I'm so glad to hear that. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
